name: [🔁] Spin a Soccer Card
desc:
💸 EARN CASH WHILE YOU SLEEP! 💸

⚽ Welcome to Spin a Soccer Card

How to Play:
🛒 Buy a pack from the Shop!
✨ Tap to unpack and reveal a random soccer card!
🏠 Place them on your plot to earn $$$!
💰 Buy more EPIC packs & flex your cards!

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
